LanguageData.CC_Settings_GuestWill: Guests join only when they would
LanguageData.CC_Settings_GuestWill_Tip: With Hospitality: a guest joins the colony of their own will only when they would. Nothing may hold them at home (a partner or young children there, their parents while they're young and not in love here, their people's leader, a faith they hold fast that isn't the colony's). They need a reason to stay: love or family here, hard times among their people, a stay that's going very well, or the colony's faith. There has to be room for one more: a free bed, a room of their own for the greedy, the jealous and the titled, and four days of food in store. And what they'd want of a home by their passions and nature has to be there: a passionate cook wants a decent kitchen, a grower fields to work, a gourmand fine meals. Until then the guest tab offers only to recruit them by force, and the Recruit button's tooltip says what's missing; Hospitality's own "a happy guest asks to join" comes only for a guest who would. What taking them costs their people goes by who they are: less with no family among them, more with family there, twice for their leader's family. Before someone is recruited from the guest tab, anyone of the colony who objects has their say at the council, and their family may come weeks later to ask for them back. Off: Hospitality's own rules alone. Needs the deeper game hooks.
